variants.name: Silent
variants.info:
Experimental XM115 made for 7.62x51mm NATO firearms.

Similar functions to a flash hider, reduces sound too.

Bullet speed and suppression reduced. Works great with suppressors!

variants.name: Hollow Point
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).

variants.name: 5.45x39mm
variants.info:
Chambers your Saiga SAR in 5.45x39mm with a 45 round magazine!
Lowers recoil, increases fire rate, magazine capacity and bullet speed while keeping a good range performance but comes at a cost of close range damage, penetration and some handling!

variants.name: 7.62x39mm
variants.info:
Chambers your Saiga SAR in 7.62x39mm with a 30rd magazine!
Keeps damage high especially to the torso while also increasing your fire rate, but lowers overall damage and penetration!

variants.name: .223 Rem
variants.info:
Chambers your Saiga SAR in .223 Rem. with a 40 round magazine!
Uses some ''legal'' modifications to the receiver to turn your SAR fully automatic. Treat this as an assault rifle with an extended magazine!

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: Armor Piercing
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

variants.name: 5.6x39mm
variants.info:
Chambers your Saiga SAR in 5.6x39mm, a 5.6mm projectile from necked down 7.62x39mm brass!
Excellent bullet speed with improved damage falloff, very lethal headshot damage and more penetration than 7.62x39mm but lowers your close range performance!
